page.notes: Printed line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin; each is given as a note at its line. The large initial S of "Scholastica" is joined to the word. Long s is written as s throughout, so "Iof." is read as Ios. The Greek-free text has no Hebrew. Some italics in the citations are approximate. Abbreviation "Par." after "1." is read as printed and could be Par. with a bar. Running head printed as BIBLICUS. with full stop. The catchword "II. Eius" is at the right foot.
